text_block_list.text:
On a day off.
While out shopping...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~! No way, no way!
I want something way more sparkly~!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch...
Who cares about appearances anyway?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
To be precise, I am being subjected to unneeded meddling.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Booo! It's Brian-san's fault
for not having party clothes in the first place!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Once you debut, you get invited to all sorts of things, right? Like pre-race eve parties and victory celebrations!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And yet...
participating in a school uniform is totally absurd!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Geez! That's not what I mean!
...Fine, I'll just have to make the two of you understand!

And so, I ended up accompanying her
to pick out clothes, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That elegant one-piece dress is gorgeous~♪
Your racing outfit is on the cooler side, so it'll make for an amazing contrast!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't like it.
Though if I tear off the hem, I suppose I could wear it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? But that was the whole point of making it cute!
You can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"That one? It's an all-in-one jumpsuit dress!
The hem is short, so it makes your legs look super stylish and long♪"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Rejected.
Those flashy colors are an eyesore.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"No waay!? If it's not this sparkly,
what's the point of wearing a dress!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *wheeze*... Arrrgh!!
I can't make up my mind at all-!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: In the first place, there's no need to decide.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"No! In that case, I am de-fi-nite-ly buying it!
I'll make you let me buy it!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Hey, hey! What kind of outfit would be good? If you just keep saying no to everything, I'll never know!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any particular preferences.
If I had to say...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...These clothes are easy to run in.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Easy to run in?
Even though it's a party dress?!
When told to think of clothes that are easy to run in, what comes to mind is—
choice_data_list: How about a suit or something!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A suit...
Well, at least it doesn't look frivolous.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's sparkly or not, but...
For now, let's just check out the shop!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even when I lift my leg, the fabric stretches well.
This should be easy to run in.

text_block_list.name: Clothing Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! So hard-boiled!
It looks terribly, amazingly good on you, customer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Woah~! High praise...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That was a surprisingly good haul.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya learned something new too!
There are cool kinds of sparkle too, huh!
It turned out to be a deeply satisfying shopping trip!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A jersey... I see, that's one way to do it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Stooop! A jersey to a party!? Just imagining it is awful, don't you think!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the invitation to the party.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Not a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"No waay!? No, no way!
The school uniform would be a hundred times better than that!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief...
That is what I have been telling you from the very beginning.
And so, our hectic shopping trip drew to a close...
